description: Polyphonic sine VCO with through-zero linear FM, a wave shaper, an ADSR and a set of VCAs, able to fold or morph its wave and to be hard-synced

params.text: Sets the base pitch in octaves, 0 to 10
Multiplies the base pitch by a whole number, 1 to 16, which is how the carrier is set against the modulator in an FM patch, despite the manual giving only 1, 2 and 3
Tunes the pitch up or down by as much as an octave
Attenuates the CV at the FM jack, which bends the pitch exponentially and suits vibrato
Sets the depth of the through-zero linear FM, and scales the CV at the Depth jack and the ADSR where those are in play
Sets the wave shaping: how much folding in fold, and how far from triangle towards saw in T/S; the sine setting ignores it
Picks what the wave shaper does: sine leaves the sine wave alone, fold runs it through a wave folder, and T/S morphs between triangle and saw
Sets how much of the oscillator's own sine wave is fed back into its modulation input, which thickens the timbre without a second oscillator
Sets the output level, which is the FM depth when this output feeds the LFM input of another Kitchen Sink
Sets the attack time of the internal ADSR
Sets the decay time of the internal ADSR
Sets the sustain level of the internal ADSR
Sets the release time of the internal ADSR
Applies the internal ADSR to the wave shape, multiplying with the Shape knob
Applies the internal ADSR to the feedback amount, multiplying with the Fdbk knob
Applies the internal ADSR to the output level, multiplying with the Level knob
Applies the internal ADSR to the linear FM depth, multiplying with the Depth knob
Adds Moog-style snap to the internal ADSR: 0 for a plain envelope, 1 for a little snap, 2 for more, which gives the envelope something of an AHDSR shape without setting a hold time

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, a volt per octave; the number of channels on this cable sets how many voices run
Bends the pitch exponentially through the FM attenuverter above it
The modulator input for through-zero linear FM, its depth set by the Depth knob; with nothing patched here the only FM available is the feedback path
Opens the internal ADSR while the gate is high, one channel per voice
Restarts the oscillator's cycle on each cycle of the signal patched here, giving the classic sync sound, and works best with a signal lower in pitch than this oscillator
Scales the wave shaping, multiplying with the Shape knob
Scales the linear FM depth, multiplying with the Depth knob
Scales the feedback amount, multiplying with the Fdbk knob

outputs.text: The oscillator after the wave shaper and the output level, polyphonic with one channel per voice

notes: the four ADSR buttons come up off, so the internal envelope changes nothing until one of them is switched on; the Gate input is what opens that envelope
with nothing patched at LFM the only frequency modulation available is the feedback path, since the Depth knob scales the LFM input
menu: Hookup Modulator — appears only while another Kitchen Sink is directly to the left, and patches that one into this module's LFM input, passing on the V/Oct and Gate cables this one has
